title.narrative: Strengthening Lifesaving Health, Nutrition, and Protection Services for Crisis-Affected Populations in Damaturu, Nguru (Yobe State), and Madagali (Adamawa State), Northeast Nigeria

description.narrative: ltpgtCOCOSOHDI in partnership with SWOGE is proposing a 6-month lifesaving health and protection project aimed at reducing morbidity and mortality among crisis-affected populations in Yobe and Adamawa States. The project prioritizes women, adolescent girls, children under five, and persons with disabilities, particularly those exposed to high risks of preventable maternal and newborn deaths, communicable disease outbreaks, acute malnutrition, and gender-based violence. It seeks to restore dignity, promote inclusion, and strengthen resilience in conflict-affected communities through integrated primary health care, sexual and reproductive health, epidemic preparedness, and protection services. Implementation will focus on Damaturu and Nguru (Yobe State) and Madagali (Adamawa State), areas identified in the 2025 HNRP and Lean Season Plan as facing critical health system gaps and heightened vulnerability.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project will directly reach 8,210 individuals with comprehensive, inclusive health and protection interventions. At least 15% of direct beneficiaries are persons with disabilities, while an estimated 26,670 individuals will be indirectly reached through community awareness, epidemic risk communication, accountability platforms, and strengthened referral systems.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project delivers three integrated outcomes:ltbrgtOutcome 1: Conflict-affected women, girls, men, and boys access inclusive, lifesaving primary health care, maternal and newborn services, nutrition screening, and structured community health education.ltbrgtOutcome 2: Women, adolescent girls, and GBV survivors, including those with disabilities, access survivor-centered sexual and reproductive health services, clinical management of rape, MHPSS, and safe spaces.ltbrgtOutcome 3: At-risk communities and facilities are better prepared for epidemic outbreaks through strengthened surveillance, case management, infection prevention, and rapid response mechanisms.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtCOCOSOHDI and SWOGE have established operational presence and community trust in all target LGAs, with embedded staff, functional partnerships with SMOHs, and active participation in the Health and Protection clusters. This presence ensures effective delivery, accountability to affected populations, and sustainability through strengthened government systems and empowered community structures.ltbrgtlt/pgt
